title: Raymond Moody's psychomanteum and the underground oracle temples of ancient Greece
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Raymond Moody's psychomanteum and the underground oracle temples of ancient Greece, about ancient Greece to the present at Greece (the ancient oracle sites), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I mean a modern example of it would be the psychoantium developed by Raymond Moody that was based on the discovery in ancient Greece of underground temples
